protocol.purpose: Short tutorial on retrospective rolling-origin burned-area forecasting
protocol.target: satellite-detected county burned-area fraction, not wildfire-specific
protocol.terrain_policy: Fixed county context, frozen from the first training month; no target-row terrain lookup
protocol.land_cover_policy: One constant category; no annual land-cover observations or changing embedding input
protocol.county_summary_policy: XGBoost expanding summaries use only response months strictly before origin
protocol.history_policy: Every response index is nonnegative and at or before origin; target horizons lie entirely inside their assigned split
protocol.availability_assumption: Monthly burned-area observations through the stated origin are assumed observed. Operational product-release latency is not modeled; these are retrospective forecasts, not a validated real-time warning service.
protocol.preprocessing: Training-only scaler; no backward filling or response imputation; no PCA in this experiment
protocol.test: 2018-06 through 2020-07; tuning and train/test diagnostic interpretation
protocol.validation: 2020-08 through 2024-12; assess each model after its configuration/checkpoint is selected on test
protocol.selection_rule: Minimum finite test NLL among COMPLETE trials, checkpoint selected by test NLL; both model examples retained
protocol.prediction_object: Single fitted parameter outputs; GNN deterministic mean-feedback rollout

limitations: Existing mapped-burn coverage flag is unusable and is excluded; this is not an observation-validity re-export.
Geography/terrain is fixed context; response release latency is an explicit retrospective-evaluation assumption.

record.selection_rule: Minimum finite test NLL among COMPLETE trials; checkpoint sliced to test-selected best_iteration + 1.
record.code_snapshot_timing: Post-run source snapshot, not a contemporaneous launch snapshot.

third_party_offset_audit.finding: Offsets/start_values are estimated only from dtrain labels and reused unchanged on train/test evaluation matrices and saved-model predictions. Prediction matrices are unlabeled.

null_schemes.month: Shuffle whole target-month positions, moving every horizon together; reindex Gram matrices, energies and valid-slice mask
null_schemes.county: Permute county labels jointly across all horizons and target months, preserving each series and the fixed graph

stacf_settings.display_rule: p_month at order 0/positive lag; p_county at positive order/lag 0; max(p_month,p_county) when both are positive
stacf_settings.multiplicity_adjustment: none; the max-of-two display rule is not a gridwise adjustment
stacf_settings.cell_text: p_display rounded to two decimals; structural (0,0) and undefined tests use an em dash

fields.county_anomaly: Cross-county mean removed within each horizon and target month

stacf_settings.pooling: Products and energies are computed separately within each horizon, then pooled over valid horizon/month pairs
stacf_settings.normalization: Each shell uses its full valid-slice mean squared energy, as in model.diagnostics._stacf
stacf_settings.graph: Row-standardized exclusive graph-distance shells; order zero is identity
stacf_settings.undefined_coefficients: null in data; grey in plots

discrimination_settings.roc_auc: Trapezoidal ROC area, equal to the tie-aware probability ranking statistic
discrimination_settings.pr_auc: Trapezoidal area under the full precision-recall curve, reported as gate_pr_auc
discrimination_settings.average_precision: Recall-step-weighted precision, reported separately as gate_average_precision
discrimination_settings.plot_sampling: First/last/min/max y retained per 1/2048 x bin, including endpoints; metrics use full curves

spatial_weights.normalization: row standardized; isolated counties have zero rows
spatial_weights.moran_formula: N / sum(W) * (z.T @ W @ z) / (z.T @ z), z centered over all county means
spatial_weights.zero_variance_or_no_edges: coefficient is undefined and stored as null

notes: All three splits use matching forecast keys and observed targets across models.
Test selects configurations and checkpoints. Validation assesses the fixed examples.
Later rolling origins may use responses observed since earlier forecasts; no target after the current origin is an input.
Positive float32 targets are promoted to float64 and scored without an epsilon response clamp.
NLL and CRPS are plug-in marginal diagnostics, not estimates of parameter or trajectory uncertainty.
Occurrence AUC/AP use scikit-learn threshold grouping, including ties.
Trapezoidal PR AUC is recorded separately from average precision; curve downsampling affects plotting only.
PIT seed 0 is applied after full-key sorting; only the normal transform clips probabilities to [1e-12,1-1e-12].
Repeated targets and spatial/temporal dependence make diagnostic curves descriptive; no row-IID tests or bands.
Spatial Moran I describes county-mean randomized residuals; temporal lag-1 r correlates consecutive target-month residual means.
Unequal temporal averaging lengths affect county means and their Moran I, so cross-split changes do not establish stronger dependence.
Training STACF preserves horizons and adds centered two-sided month/county permutation p-values; cells use decimal p-values without stars or thresholds.
No prediction quantiles, interval coverage, parameter ensembles, or definitive class winner are reported.
